C-RELEASE-0-4-1-280.Summary: Prepare and publish Kafedra Planner 0.4.1 from the exact verified main without changing product or database behavior.
C-RELEASE-0-4-1-280.Problem: Main contains completed reliability and desktop-plan improvements after v0.4.0, but release metadata, validation contracts and publisher wiring still identify 0.4.0, so these verified changes are not yet available as an immutable installable release.

Goals.Goal: Synchronize all authoritative version markers and release documentation to 0.4.1.
Retarget the release gate and publisher to Release gate 0.4.1 while preserving exact-main, no-op and immutable-tag safeguards.
Publish only changes already reachable from exact main and preserve SQLite schema 31, immutable sources, offline operation and optional LLM behavior.
Prove the full release, offline bundle, systemd, backup/restore, browser, database and Project Control contracts before publication.

Constraints.Constraint: No application runtime code, public UI, SQLite schema, migration, dependency version, immutable source/evidence or stored data semantics may change.
Tag and release v0.4.0 and all of its assets remain unchanged.
Version 0.4.1 remains a release candidate until real Astra Linux/Debian target acceptance is completed under issue 27.
No Docker, CDN, cloud service, Internet connection or LLM becomes a production runtime requirement.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Implement issue 254 or any new mobile plan interaction.
Add a schema migration or normalize historical data.
Modify product code already completed by the changes included in 0.4.1.
Declare stable production acceptance for Astra Linux/Debian.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: VERSION, package metadata, README RU/EN, ROADMAP, UX_FLOWS, VALIDATION, RELEASE_CANDIDATE and TARGET_ACCEPTANCE consistently identify 0.4.1 with schema 31.
Release gate workflow and publisher both use `Release gate 0.4.1`; regression tests enforce that exact contract.
`docs/releases/0.4.1.md` accurately summarizes only completed changes reachable from the exact base.
GRACE final and every mandatory exact-head project check succeed, including unit/browser, database, release gate, full offline Debian 12, systemd, offline LLM/GGUF and Project Control.
The release PR is squash-merged only from its unchanged verified head and the new exact main passes post-merge CI.
GitHub Release v0.4.1 is public, non-prerelease, points to the verified release main commit and contains exactly the required seven assets with valid SHA-256 checksums.
The completed change is moved to terminal `applied` state by a separate archive-only PR after publication verification.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The unchanged release head contains only version, release documentation/workflow/test changes plus the approved GRACE bundle; GitHub then proves exact-head CI and published v0.4.1 assets.
